pixafilm.Selection: Select, move and trim clips in the timeline. Drag a clip body to move it or an edge to adjust a cut.
pixafilm.TrackSelectForward: Select clips from the clicked position forward so a group of later edits can move together.
pixafilm.TrackSelectBackward: Select clips before the clicked position for a coordinated timeline move.
pixafilm.Ripple: Trim a clip while closing or opening the adjacent timeline gap; later clips can shift.
pixafilm.Rolling: Move a cut between neighboring clips while keeping their combined duration unchanged.
pixafilm.RateStretch: Change a clip's timeline duration by changing playback speed. Check the resulting motion and audio.
pixafilm.Remix: Adjust music to fit a target duration. Listen to the transitions before exporting.
pixafilm.Razor: Cut a clip at the clicked timeline position. Select the pieces afterward to move or remove them.
pixafilm.Slip: Change which source frames appear inside a clip without moving its timeline boundaries.
pixafilm.Slide: Move a clip while trimming its neighboring clips to preserve the surrounding sequence length.
pixafilm.Pen: Add or adjust clip keyframes to change properties over time.
pixafilm.Rectangle: Draw a rectangular graphic or mask in the viewer.
pixafilm.Ellipse: Draw an elliptical graphic or mask in the viewer.
pixafilm.Hand: Pan the timeline or viewer without moving project content.
pixafilm.Zoom: Change the timeline or viewer magnification; this does not change export resolution.
pixafilm.Type: Create or edit horizontal text for titles and graphics.
pixafilm.VerticalType: Create or edit text arranged vertically.

pixasound.Zoom: Change timeline magnification to inspect samples or see a larger section of the session.
pixasound.Trim: Adjust the beginning or end of an audio clip. Work nondestructively and keep the original recording.
pixasound.Selector: Place the edit cursor or select a time range for an edit or playback.
pixasound.Grabber: Select and move clips on the timeline. Check snapping and edit mode before moving.
pixasound.Scrubber: Audition audio around the pointer to locate a precise edit position.
pixasound.Pencil: Draw supported editable data such as automation. Choose the appropriate lane first.
pixasound.Smart: Combine editing gestures according to the pointer position within the clip; watch the cursor to see the active action.

pixatexture.Paint: Paint the enabled material channels onto the selected mesh layer with the current brush.
pixatexture.Eraser: Remove paint from the selected paint layer. Keep an original or duplicate layer while learning.
pixatexture.Projection: Project an image or material onto the mesh; position the projection before applying it.
pixatexture.PolygonFill: Fill mesh polygons, objects or UV regions with the selected material settings.
pixatexture.Smudge: Drag existing painted detail to blend or smear it across the surface.
pixatexture.Clone: Copy texture detail from a sampled source region to another region.
pixatexture.ColorPicker: Sample a surface color for the active paint settings.
pixatexture.Path: Paint along an editable curve, or fill a closed curve. Adjust the path before committing the result.
pixatexture.GeometryMask: Show or hide the selected layer on clicked mesh parts; inspect the mask before painting further.

pixainterface.Move: Select and reposition objects on the canvas. Use the properties panel for exact values.
pixainterface.Scale: Resize a selection proportionally, including supported visual properties.
pixainterface.Hand: Pan the canvas without changing the design.
pixainterface.Frame: Draw a container for a screen, component or layout. Put related objects inside it.
pixainterface.Section: Group regions of the canvas into named sections for organization.
pixainterface.Slice: Mark a rectangular export region without changing the design's objects.
pixainterface.Rectangle: Draw a rectangular vector shape; adjust fill, stroke and corner radius afterward.
pixainterface.Line: Draw a straight line between two points.
pixainterface.Arrow: Draw a line with an arrowhead for direction or annotation.
pixainterface.Polygon: Draw a regular polygon and adjust its sides in the properties panel.
pixainterface.Star: Draw a star and adjust its points and shape properties.
pixainterface.Pen: Place vector points and handles to draw an editable path.
pixainterface.Text: Create and edit text on the canvas.
pixainterface.TextOnPath: Place text along an editable vector path.
pixainterface.Comment: Attach a comment to a location in the design for review.
pixainterface.Eyedropper: Sample a color from visible content.
pixainterface.ShapeBuilder: Combine or remove regions formed by overlapping selected shapes.
pixainterface.Sticky: Place a sticky note on a board for a short idea or annotation.
pixainterface.BoardShape: Add a board shape for diagrams or visual organization.
pixainterface.Connector: Connect board objects with a line that follows their positions.
pixainterface.Marker: Draw a freehand mark on a board.
pixainterface.Highlighter: Draw a translucent highlight over board content.
pixainterface.Eraser: Remove board ink strokes. Check which content is selected before erasing.
pixainterface.Stamp: Place a stamp on a board to annotate or react to content.

pixavector.selection: Select and transform whole objects. Drag a selection boundary or use the properties panel for exact values.
pixavector.directSelection: Select individual anchor points or path segments for precise shape edits.
pixavector.groupSelection: Select an object within a group without ungrouping the artwork.
pixavector.magicWand: Select objects with matching visual attributes, using the tool's tolerance settings.
pixavector.lasso: Draw around anchor points or objects to select them.
pixavector.pen: Place anchor points and drag direction handles to draw an editable path.
pixavector.addAnchor: Add an anchor to an existing path segment for finer control.
pixavector.deleteAnchor: Remove an anchor from a path. Inspect the curve after the change.
pixavector.anchorPoint: Convert a point between a corner and a smooth curve, or edit its handles.
pixavector.curvature: Draw and reshape curved paths by placing curve points.
pixavector.areaType: Put text inside a closed area so it wraps within the shape.
pixavector.typeOnPath: Place text along a path and adjust its position on that path.
pixavector.verticalType: Create point text with a vertical writing direction.
pixavector.verticalAreaType: Flow vertical text inside a closed area.
pixavector.verticalTypeOnPath: Place vertically oriented text along a path.
pixavector.touchType: Adjust individual characters' position, rotation or scale within text.
pixavector.spiral: Draw a spiral and adjust its geometry.
pixavector.rectangularGrid: Draw a rectangular arrangement of grid lines.
pixavector.polarGrid: Draw a circular grid with radial and concentric divisions.
pixavector.rectangle: Draw a rectangle and adjust its dimensions.
pixavector.roundedRectangle: Draw a rectangle with rounded corners.
pixavector.star: Draw a star with adjustable point geometry.
pixavector.flare: Create a flare-style vector object and adjust its appearance.
pixavector.paintbrush: Draw a path using the selected brush appearance.
pixavector.blobBrush: Paint filled vector shapes that can combine with compatible nearby regions.
pixavector.shaper: Sketch gestures to form or combine vector shapes.
pixavector.pencil: Draw a freehand path that remains editable as vector geometry.
pixavector.smooth: Reduce abrupt bends along an existing path.
pixavector.pathEraser: Erase part of a selected path rather than erasing raster pixels.
pixavector.join: Connect compatible path ends. Select the intended open ends first.
pixavector.eraser: Remove regions from selected vector artwork.
pixavector.scissors: Split a path at a chosen point.
pixavector.knife: Cut vector shapes along a drawn cutting stroke.
pixavector.mirrorCut: Cut artwork using a mirrored cutting operation.
pixavector.lineCut: Cut artwork along a straight line.
pixavector.rectCut: Cut artwork using a rectangular region.
pixavector.rotate: Rotate selected artwork around a reference point.
pixavector.reflect: Mirror selected artwork about an axis.
pixavector.scale: Change selected artwork's size. Check aspect-ratio constraints before dragging.
pixavector.shear: Slant selected artwork while preserving straight edges.
pixavector.reshape: Adjust the shape of a selected path by moving a region of its geometry.
pixavector.width: Vary stroke width along a path.
pixavector.warp: Push or pull the outline of vector artwork with a distortion brush.
pixavector.twirl: Twist nearby vector geometry around the pointer.
pixavector.scallop: Add repeated rounded distortions along an outline.
pixavector.crystallize: Create pointed distortions along an outline.
pixavector.wrinkle: Create irregular ripples in an outline.
pixavector.freeTransform: Move, scale, rotate or distort a selected object with transform handles.
pixavector.puppetWarp: Place and move pins to deform artwork locally.
pixavector.shapeBuilder: Combine or remove overlapping regions of selected shapes.
pixavector.livePaintBucket: Fill regions in a live-paint arrangement with the chosen color or appearance.
pixavector.livePaintSelection: Select individual live-paint regions or edges.
pixavector.perspectiveGrid: Set up a perspective grid to guide artwork placement.
pixavector.perspectiveSelection: Move or scale artwork in relation to the perspective grid.
pixavector.mesh: Create or edit mesh points that control smooth color transitions.
pixavector.gradient: Create or adjust a gradient's direction, stops and spread.
pixavector.eyedropper: Sample supported appearance attributes from another object.
pixavector.measure: Measure the distance and angle between points.
pixavector.blend: Create intermediate artwork between selected objects.
pixavector.objectsOnPath: Arrange repeated objects along a path.
pixavector.dimension: Place dimension annotations on measured geometry.
pixavector.symbolSprayer: Place multiple instances of a symbol.
pixavector.symbolShifter: Move symbol instances within a symbol set.
pixavector.symbolScruncher: Move symbol instances closer together or farther apart.
pixavector.symbolSizer: Change the size of symbol instances.
pixavector.symbolStainer: Tint symbol instances with the selected color.
pixavector.symbolStyler: Apply appearance styles to symbol instances.
pixavector.columnGraph: Create a graph with vertical columns from entered data.
pixavector.stackedColumnGraph: Create vertical columns divided into stacked data series.
pixavector.barGraph: Create a graph with horizontal bars.
pixavector.stackedBarGraph: Create horizontal bars divided into stacked data series.
pixavector.lineGraph: Plot data series as connected lines.
pixavector.areaGraph: Plot data series as filled areas.
pixavector.scatterGraph: Plot pairs of numeric values as points.
pixavector.pieGraph: Display data proportions as pie segments.
pixavector.radarGraph: Compare values along axes radiating from a common center.
pixavector.artboard: Create and resize artboards that define separate output areas.
pixavector.slice: Mark an output slice within the artwork.
pixavector.sliceSelection: Select and adjust existing output slices.
pixavector.hand: Pan the canvas without moving artwork.
pixavector.rotateView: Rotate the canvas view without rotating the artwork.
pixavector.printTiling: Adjust how the artwork is divided across printed pages.
pixavector.zoom: Change view magnification without changing document resolution or geometry.
